shelters.name: Nashville Humane Association
shelters.description: Since 1946, dedicated to aiding sick, homeless and at-risk shelter pets. Voted Nashville's Favorite Place to Adopt with 98% save rate.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Memphis and Shelby County
shelters.description: Rescues and adopts animals, promotes humane treatment through education. Provides low-cost vaccines and affordable spay/neuter for Shelby County residents.

shelters.name: Humane Society of the Tennessee Valley
shelters.description: Committed to joining companion animals and people who love them. Supports 55 partner shelters and transfers animals from throughout the state.

shelters.name: Young-Williams Animal Center
shelters.description: One of the largest animal welfare organizations in East Tennessee. Provides shelter, adoption, and community programs.

shelters.name: SPCA of Tennessee
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) non-profit founded 20 years ago. Foster-based rescue run by volunteers helping all 96 Tennessee counties.

shelters.name: Humane Educational Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit providing adoption services, animal protection, cruelty investigation, and pet licenses for Hamilton County. Educates public on proper animal care.

shelters.name: Metro Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: Metro Nashville's official animal care and control facility providing shelter services and animal welfare programs.

shelters.name: Memphis Animal Services
shelters.description: City of Memphis animal services providing shelter, adoption, and animal control services.

shelters.name: Sevier County Humane Society
shelters.description: Inspires community compassion and respect for animals. Improves quality of life through education, spay/neuter, and adoption services.

shelters.name: The Bridge Home No Kill Animal Rescue
shelters.description: No-kill animal rescue serving the Tri-Cities region of northeast Tennessee.

shelters.name: Saving The Animals Together
shelters.description: Foster-based rescue reducing animals killed in Madison County. Runs monthly pet food pantry for owners in financial crisis.

shelters.name: Friends of Campbell County Animals
shelters.description: Preserves animal life through humane sheltering, promoting adoptions, fostering rescue efforts, and affordable spay/neuter.

shelters.name: Humphreys County Humane Society
shelters.description: Non-profit saving abandoned, abused, neglected, and lost animals in Humphreys County.

shelters.name: Old Friends Senior Dog Sanctuary
shelters.description: Sanctuary providing forever home for senior dogs whose owners can no longer care for them or who have outlived their owners.

shelters.name: Big Fluffy Dog Rescue
shelters.description: Rescues, rehabilitates, and finds homes for giant breed dogs and mixes facing euthanasia.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Tennessee animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Nashville Humane Association (since 1946) has 98% save rate. Humane Society of Tennessee Valley supports 55 partner shelters statewide. Coverage spans Nashville, Memphis, Knoxville, Chattanooga, and surrounding regions.
